rows.method: opened first-two-row limit; approved support seam checked separately

cloth_profiles.definition: Remove the existing smoothstep anatomical attachment blend before measuring the drape profile. Standoff uses the smoothed live torso/pelvis sagittal envelope at the eased drape station. The singular support seam uses the measured limit extrapolated from the first two drape rows and is separately checked against its approved attachment.

fold_amplitude_rows.method: opened first-two-row limit; approved support seam checked separately

proportions.definition: Front capture camera at the shared proof scale (the contact sheet shows the original at 4x beside the clay at 1:1 on one sole line). Heights: above the lowest body pixel row (sole line); widths: screen extent; both over the registered H (the original's 232 px = 928 capture px). Limb widths: widest perpendicular screen extent over the central half of the segment. body_over_H: the 3D body-space value over the inherited H gauge.

hands.definition: Phalanx axes from opened ring centroids; MCP curl is the proximal axis out of the palm plane (palm PCA normal), PIP/DIP the angles between successive phalanx axes; spread is between adjacent proximal axes in the palm plane. Far wrap: angular sweep of each finger's joint points about the measured shaft axis.

elbow_near.overlap_definition: max axial reach of cop vertices along each neighbouring segment beyond the joint

elbow_far.overlap_definition: max axial reach of cop vertices along each neighbouring segment beyond the joint

knee_near.overlap_definition: max axial reach of cop vertices along each neighbouring segment beyond the joint

knee_far.overlap_definition: max axial reach of cop vertices along each neighbouring segment beyond the joint

helm.definition: Head frame from the native head bone (forward) and the head-to-tip axis. Crown = the helm top; tine rises are the highest centreline station above it; hook = apex minus topmost station along head forward.

bell.definition: Native torso frame. Cage front = rib-band vertices within 0.012 H of the sternum plane; the bell must lie behind their inner face, its mouth within 0.003 H of their lowest edge, its top below the sternum top.

ribs.definition: Band centreline = mean of its skin vertices per station; thickness = its greatest two-skin separation. Turn = signed tangent rotation from the sternum end outward, in the chest plan and on the front capture. Cage yaw: the near/far outer-end line of each rib pair against the native torso frame (bone facing and spine) in the chest plane; its world yaw is reported beside the torso facing yaw.

hood_fall.definition: Mantle mid-surface back column (phi = pi) in the native torso frame; signed distance of every interior row outside the straight neck-to-hem chord. Positive is a hump.

tines_above_hood.definition: Depth-tested piece raster of the head region in each capture camera; a tine is clearly visible when its visible pixels above the hood cowl's topmost pixel row span at least 0.06 H on screen.

joint_sphericity.definition: Per capture camera and joint: pixel-centre rays within the projected 0.04 H window; hits within 0.04 H of the joint form its visible region; a least-squares sphere is fitted; sphere fraction = share of hits within 12% radial residual and 15 degrees normal agreement; normal isotropy = sqrt of the ratio of the two largest normal spreads. A joint region is a near-sphere when sphere fraction > 0.5 AND isotropy > 0.45; a visible ball scores near 1 on both. worst_score_over_limit = max over regions of min(fraction/0.5, isotropy/0.45).

definition: H and L retain the mq-17 gauges. Proportions are sprite-style front-capture measurements over the registered H (see proportions.definition).

cloak_occlusion.definition: Native rear pixel-centre rays through torso solo. Two cutoff domains are reported without choosing one: opened torso hits below the 3D level-shoulder plane, and pixels below the 2D projected shoulder line. New cloak plus its retained overlapping hood cape/scarf must be closer than or on the torso. The torso denominator includes those garments. New-cloak-only 3D-plane coverage is reported separately. Tears count as uncovered. No hole fill or surface-vertex weighting.

attachment.lap_definition: world Z above opened native local hem; both skins have a real outward support ray hit

front_far_exposure.definition: Native polygon silhouette left edge at pixel-centre scanlines; all body/arm pieces except staff and cloak form the comparison. Cloak solo is conservative even when occluded.
